summary: YSX Tech Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held October 19, 2026, the ordinary-course foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on shareholder vote results. Shareholders approved an authorized share capital increase from US$50,000 to US$220,000,000 (2.0 trillion Class A and 200 billion Class B shares of US$0.0001 par), a reduction of general meeting notice to five clear days, and amended articles. Votes were overwhelmingly in favor; no transaction terms, advisor, or board recommendation beyond the proposals. Watch for dilution implications and future issuances, not deal arbitrage.
